page.layout: One page of text, single column; a woodcut ornament at the head; a library stamp at upper right (not transcribed); a footnote-style catchword and page marker at the foot.

main_text.head: Nobilissimo & Amplissimo viro CASPARO VOSBERGIO EQVITI, Domino in Eisla, perpetuo Zelandorum inter Præpotentes Ordines Generales Senatori: ad Galliarum Regem &c. Exlegato.
main_text.p: NVlla animi arrogantia, vel ut ait ille, ἰπποδυφία, eò assurgere non extimesco, ut quem patriæ primores in sublimi loco collocarunt, ad eum familiarius accedam: quasi de illa familiaritate posthac gloriaturus, veluti Ἐ Διὸς σάνδαλον, Iovis sandalium, secundum proverbium vetus. Longè aliud, huic epistolæ causam

page.notes: Initial N is a large woodcut decorated letter, transcribed as N. The Greek phrase "ἰπποδυφία" in the printed line is read as printed with doubtful letters; "Ἐ Διὸς σάνδαλον" likewise. The phrase "ille, ἰπποδυφία" may be misprinted; the printed form is uncertain. The stamp "Biblioteca Nazionale Roma" is omitted.
